MAGICSWORDSMAN-COMBO.title: Combo
MAGICSWORDSMAN-COMBO.description: Triggers if your [gold]current sword[/gold] was already this card's sword right before you played it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-PAIR.title: Pair
MAGICSWORDSMAN-PAIR.description: Ganjiang and Moye only. Triggers if your [gold]current sword[/gold] right before playing was the other one (Ganjiang <-> Moye). [gold]Twin Swords[/gold] cards always trigger it, and the next Ganjiang/Moye card right after a Twin Swords card triggers it too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_SWORD.title: Twin Swords
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_SWORD.description: Counts as both Ganjiang and Moye. The first time you play one, both are summoned. It gets both Ganjiang's effect (damage) and Moye's effect (Block); afterwards your current sword is Ganjiang.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-COMMAND.title: Command
MAGICSWORDSMAN-COMMAND.description: [gold]Onimaru[/gold] immediately acts once in its current stance. Current-sword bonus applies; never a random stance.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DRAW_CUT.title: Draw-cut
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DRAW_CUT.description: An attack that spends all of [gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold]'s [gold]Light[/gold]. This card's damage ignores [gold]Block[/gold].
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CURRENT_SWORD.title: Current Sword
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CURRENT_SWORD.description: The magic sword you are holding now; its effect applies. Playing a sword card makes that sword current (summoning it the first time). Common cards do not change the current sword.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION.title: Union
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION.description:
Only offered in card rewards, shops and transforms while BOTH [gold]{SwordA}[/gold] and [gold]{SwordB}[/gold] are in [gold]Mangeomchong[/gold].
Playing it makes the first sword your [gold]current sword[/gold] and summons the second one too. Its numbers follow both swords' levels.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION.popupBody:
While you hold both swords, this [purple]Union[/purple] card can appear in card rewards and shops.
Playing it summons both swords and they move together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION.popupContinue: Click or press any key to continue
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_SWORD_EFFECT.title: {Sword} effect
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_GRAM_LEVEL.title: Gram's Effect
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_GRAM_LEVEL.descripti: While [gold]Gram[/gold] is your [gold]current sword[/gold], each hit of your attacks deals extra damage equal to Gram's upgrade level (+0 at level 0 to +5 at level 5). The first time in a run Gram reaches level 5, you get the curse [gold]Nibelung Treasure[/gold] (cannot be removed).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_PAIR_BLADES.title: Ganjiang and Moye
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_PAIR_BLADES.descript: While [gold]Ganjiang[/gold] is your [gold]current sword[/gold], your attacks deal more damage; while [gold]Moye[/gold] is, you gain more [gold]Block[/gold] from cards. Alternating Ganjiang and Moye cards triggers [gold]Pair[/gold].
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_INHERIT.title: Inherit
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_INHERIT.description: While [gold]Kusanagi[/gold] is your [gold]current sword[/gold], it inherits the effect of the sword you held right before it, at half strength (rounded down, min 1). That sword's cost is not inherited.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_PURIFY.title: Purification
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_PURIFY.description: Effects that [gold]Exhaust[/gold] Status or Curse cards, or reduce or remove your debuffs (the debuff with the largest amount first).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_KUSANAGI_LIMIT.title: Kusanagi Switch-ins
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_KUSANAGI_LIMIT.descr: You can switch into [gold]Kusanagi[/gold] from another sword at most 2 times per combat. Once they are used up, Kusanagi goes back into the tomb for the rest of the combat when it stops being current, and its cards can no longer be played.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_AUTO_ATTACK.title: Onimaru's Auto Attack
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_AUTO_ATTACK.descript: [gold]Onimaru[/gold] is out from the start of combat and acts once in its stance at the end of each of your turns: [gold]Iai[/gold] (one enemy) / [gold]Ranbu[/gold] (random enemies, several hits) / [gold]Giri[/gold] (all enemies) / [gold]Taima[/gold] (damage + Weak) / [gold]Goei[/gold] (Block). The stance follows the last stance card you played; in normal fights there is a 25% chance of a random stance.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_THREE_HILLS.title: Caladbolg's Effect
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MECH_THREE_HILLS.descript: While [gold]Caladbolg[/gold] is your [gold]current sword[/gold], attacks that target one enemy also hit other random enemies, up to 3 in total, for the same damage. But when only one enemy is left, your attacks deal less damage (20% at level 0 to 10% at level 5).
